to temporarily improve the look of moderate to severe forehead lines, crow’s feet lines, frown lines
between the eyebrows, and vertical bands connecting the jaw and neck (platysma bands) in adults.

sind. Bei erfolgreichem Abschluss der Schulung erhalten Sie ein von uns ausgestelltes Zertifikat,
welches das gelungene Abschließen der Ausbildung bestätigt.

## High-End Anti-Aging Geräte von Kopf bis Fuß

### Das ist Beautyskin-Germany

Beautyskin-Germany verkauft und entwickelt professionelle Beauty-Geräte, die nachweislich dauerhafte
Haarentfernung sowie Bodyforming und Anti-Aging möglich machen. Unsere hochwertigen Geräte
entsprechen den neuesten Standards (MDD 93/42/EWG Medizinprodukterichtlinie) und sind
wissenschaftlich geprüft. Wir legen großen Wert auf ein einfaches Handling, geringe Betriebskosten
und lange Lebensdauer.

Unsere Geräte zur dauerhaften Haarentfernung, Körperformung und Gesichtsverjüngung finden ihren
Einsatz vor allem bei Ärzten, Kosmetikstudios und Fitnessstudios. Sie decken folgende
Anwendungsbereiche ab:

- Dauerhafte Haarentfernung
- Figurverschönerung – Fettreduktion
- Cellulitereduktion- glatte und schöne Beine
- Muskelaufbau
- Hautverjüngung – Anti-Aging
- Tattooentfernung

Alle Systeme werden individuell geschult und mit passenden Werbe- sowie Marketingunterlagen
ausgeliefert.

Wir sind auch in der Lage Finanzierungen zu vermitteln und einen zeitnahen Service sicherstellen.

[Vbeam Pro]

### Vbeam Pro^{®}*: The future of vascular laser treatments

Experience the power of PRO—Precise, Reliable, Optimized—Candela’s most advanced and versatile
pulsed dye laser (PDL) and Nd:YAG device. Vbeam Pro offers dual wavelengths for 45 medical
indications across a wide range of skin types, unprecedented PDL output accuracy, optimized dye
life, and a 15 mm treatment spot size for deeper penetration and faster treatments. As the only
vascular laser FDA-cleared for pediatric treatments, Vbeam Pro delivers the power of 595 nm with the
flexibility of 1064 nm* to redefine what’s possible in laser treatments.

*Available in North America only.
[More Info][99]

## Physician's Perspective

We've offered complementary treatments with the Sublative RF and Matrix Pro applicators and have
seen improvement in the patient’s skin luminosity, texture, and overall skin appearance as soon as
one-week post-treatment. The Sublative RF applicator effectively resurfaces the skin, while the
Matrix Pro applicator stimulates new collagen growth with a completely customized treatment. Patient
satisfaction has gone through the roof after receiving these complementary treatments.

Scott Gerrish, DO

Leading Expert in Regenerative Medicine and Esthetics

I have tried FOUR different microneedling pens at my practice, both cosmetic and medical. My
experiences varied; some were cheap, not FDA-cleared, had cartridges that would skip, drag or break,
were heavy, and/or were loud. The Exceed medical microneedling device is my preferred choice! It’s
ergonomic design and lightweight handpiece make it easier to handle, while the patented tilting
plate glides nicely, allowing me to reach every inch of my patients’ face without dragging. In my
opinion, it delivers optimal results with the best healing time.

Tara Delle Chiaie, MSN, FNP-BC, APRN

Owner of Delle Chiaie Cosmetic Medicine

The Matrix^{™} system and its Matrix Pro applicator take radiofrequency to a whole new level. The
versatility of the Matrix system, with its user-controlled depth and energy settings, allows the
user to easily tailor treatment depths and the number of passes to accommodate each patient’s
anatomy and comfort level. Using only topical numbing, my patients have been extremely happy with
their results and report low pain scores with minimal downtime.^{**}

Gilly Munavalli, MD, MHS, FACMS

Board-certified Dermatologist and Fellowship-trained Mohs Surgeon

I’ve had the GentleMax Pro laser system now for about ten years and we use it for a full range of
skin types and hair types. It’s a very versatile device; we also use it for vascular malformations,
even small angiomas; you can use it for telangientasias, you can use it for some forms of rosacea,
even some port wine stains.

I would recommend the GentleMax Pro laser system to my colleagues for lots of reasons, but primarily
because it’s so reliable and powerful.

E. Victor Ross, MD

Dermatologist, Scripps Clinic, San Diego, CA

The GentleMax Pro device is a very versatile laser system for hair removal and more. It has two
wavelengths, the 755 nm Alexandrite and the 1064 nm Nd:YAG. The advantage of having both wavelengths
in one system is that we can treat patients of all skin types and a broad range of hair types with
one device.

The GentleMax Pro laser system is also a great way to expand your practice. Many patients who come
in and experience hair removal with the system, then also become interested in treating other
cosmetic concerns. This is not only true for women but for men as well. We have men who come in for
treating hair on their backs and shoulders, and then realize they can benefit from other treatments
such as brown spots and rosacea, really broadening treatment opportunities.

Arielle Kauvar, MD

Dermatologist, Founding Director of New York Laser & Skin Care, NY

Often laser hair removal brings patients into my practice; but the way you keep them in your
practice, is number one, you provide a great service, so that means you deliver long lasting hair
reductions. That’s why the GentleMax Pro laser is so important because I get happy, satisfied
patients that ultimately move on to other procedures which grows my aesthetic business. If you’re
going to be offering any service, particularly laser hair removal, you have to choose the best, and
the GentleMax Pro system is the number one laser hair removal device on the market.

Terrence Keaney, MD, FAAD

Co-founder of SkinDC, Washington DC

The PicoWay Nd:YAG laser allows us to treat a broader range of skin types and a wide array of tattoo
ink colors. With the ultra-short picosecond pulse duration, there is less discomfort during
treatment and faster healing. Professional and multicolored tattoos are cleared in far fewer
treatment sessions than with conventional Q-switched lasers.

Arielle N.B. Kauvar, MD

Director, New York Laser & Skin Care, USA

Our Vbeam Perfecta is one of the main work horse lasers in our clinic. It is very easy to use and

with editors and clinical experts rigorously testing and reviewing hundreds of solutions each year.
This year, Matrix rose to the top, earning recognition for its demonstrated efficacy in improving
acne scarring and overall skin texture. Selected after six months of evaluation and input from

[Candela Medical - Manufacturer of the Year Aesthetics Award]

## Manufacturer of the Year Award

Candela has been honored with the prestigious Manufacturer of the Year Award at The Aesthetics
Awards, hosted by the renowned Aesthetics Journal. This award holds immense significance as it
symbolizes unparalleled achievement and innovation within the aesthetics industry. Determined
through a rigorous process blending expert evaluation and public voting, it reflects Candela’s
commitment to excellence and advancement in aesthetic technology. The company takes immense pride in
this recognition, which further affirms its dedication to providing the highest quality devices and
service to the medical and aesthetic community.

[View Product Portfolio][98]

[Vbeam Pro]

### Vbeam Pro^{®}*: The future of vascular laser treatments

Experience the power of PRO—Precise, Reliable, Optimized—Candela’s most advanced and versatile
pulsed dye laser (PDL) and Nd:YAG device. Vbeam Pro offers dual wavelengths for 45 medical
indications across a wide range of skin types, unprecedented PDL output accuracy, optimized dye
life, and a 15 mm treatment spot size for deeper penetration and faster treatments. As the only
vascular laser FDA-cleared for pediatric treatments, Vbeam Pro delivers the power of 595 nm with the
flexibility of 1064 nm* to redefine what’s possible in laser treatments.

*Available in North America only.
[More Info][99]

## Physician's Perspective

We've offered complementary treatments with the Sublative RF and Matrix Pro applicators and have
seen improvement in the patient’s skin luminosity, texture, and overall skin appearance as soon as
one-week post-treatment. The Sublative RF applicator effectively resurfaces the skin, while the
Matrix Pro applicator stimulates new collagen growth with a completely customized treatment. Patient
satisfaction has gone through the roof after receiving these complementary treatments.

Scott Gerrish, DO

Leading Expert in Regenerative Medicine and Esthetics

I have tried FOUR different microneedling pens at my practice, both cosmetic and medical. My
experiences varied; some were cheap, not FDA-cleared, had cartridges that would skip, drag or break,
were heavy, and/or were loud. The Exceed medical microneedling device is my preferred choice! It’s
ergonomic design and lightweight handpiece make it easier to handle, while the patented tilting
plate glides nicely, allowing me to reach every inch of my patients’ face without dragging. In my
opinion, it delivers optimal results with the best healing time.

Tara Delle Chiaie, MSN, FNP-BC, APRN

Owner of Delle Chiaie Cosmetic Medicine

The Matrix^{™} system and its Matrix Pro applicator take radiofrequency to a whole new level. The
versatility of the Matrix system, with its user-controlled depth and energy settings, allows the
user to easily tailor treatment depths and the number of passes to accommodate each patient’s
anatomy and comfort level. Using only topical numbing, my patients have been extremely happy with
their results and report low pain scores with minimal downtime.^{**}

Gilly Munavalli, MD, MHS, FACMS

Board-certified Dermatologist and Fellowship-trained Mohs Surgeon

I’ve had the GentleMax Pro laser system now for about ten years and we use it for a full range of
skin types and hair types. It’s a very versatile device; we also use it for vascular malformations,
even small angiomas; you can use it for telangientasias, you can use it for some forms of rosacea,
even some port wine stains.

I would recommend the GentleMax Pro laser system to my colleagues for lots of reasons, but primarily
because it’s so reliable and powerful.

E. Victor Ross, MD

Dermatologist, Scripps Clinic, San Diego, CA

The GentleMax Pro device is a very versatile laser system for hair removal and more. It has two
wavelengths, the 755 nm Alexandrite and the 1064 nm Nd:YAG. The advantage of having both wavelengths
in one system is that we can treat patients of all skin types and a broad range of hair types with
one device.

The GentleMax Pro laser system is also a great way to expand your practice. Many patients who come
in and experience hair removal with the system, then also become interested in treating other
cosmetic concerns. This is not only true for women but for men as well. We have men who come in for
treating hair on their backs and shoulders, and then realize they can benefit from other treatments
such as brown spots and rosacea, really broadening treatment opportunities.

Arielle Kauvar, MD

Dermatologist, Founding Director of New York Laser & Skin Care, NY

Often laser hair removal brings patients into my practice; but the way you keep them in your
practice, is number one, you provide a great service, so that means you deliver long lasting hair
reductions. That’s why the GentleMax Pro laser is so important because I get happy, satisfied
patients that ultimately move on to other procedures which grows my aesthetic business. If you’re
going to be offering any service, particularly laser hair removal, you have to choose the best, and
the GentleMax Pro system is the number one laser hair removal device on the market.

Terrence Keaney, MD, FAAD

Co-founder of SkinDC, Washington DC

The PicoWay Nd:YAG laser allows us to treat a broader range of skin types and a wide array of tattoo
ink colors. With the ultra-short picosecond pulse duration, there is less discomfort during
treatment and faster healing. Professional and multicolored tattoos are cleared in far fewer
treatment sessions than with conventional Q-switched lasers.

Arielle N.B. Kauvar, MD

Director, New York Laser & Skin Care, USA

Our Vbeam Perfecta is one of the main work horse lasers in our clinic. It is very easy to use and
**gives us reliable results for multiple conditions**. Proven technology and reliability of the
results we get with the Vbeam Perfecta are the main reasons we use it so often, and the cryogen
cooling allows **very easy treatment of countered areas**, such as the area around the nose

Brian Zelickson, MD

Director of the Zel Skin & Laser Specialists, Edina, MN

The Candela Vbeam Perfecta has a history of unparalleled results, proven patient satisfaction and
versatility. I use the Vbeam Perfecta to treat an extremely wide range of conditions. The results,
reliability and proven success of the Vbeam Perfecta cannot be beat.

Eric Bernstein, MD, M.S.E.

Founder of the Main Line Center for Laser Surgery, Ardmore, PA

The broad range of indications for pulsed-dye laser is so extensive, well tolerated, and provides
clinically proven results. We find that in our clinical practice the Vbeam lasers are used all day
long.

Roy Geronemus, MD

Director of the Laser & Skin Surgery Center of New York - New York, NY

My patients are seeing and feeling the difference, as well. They state the Exceed device causes
minimal discomfort and bruising, which allows me to give a more thorough treatment. I also have
peace of mind knowing I am offering my patients the highest standard of care with a microneedling
device that is FDA-cleared for an effective and safe treatment.

Girish Munavalli, MD, MHS, FACMS

## Designer and distributor of
## professional aesthetic devices since 2005.

### CellSound®

Cellsound is a non invasive technology using **electric stimulation** and
**non focused ultrasound** to achieve fat cell reduction, skin tightening and face rejuvenation. 

[CellSound ®][36]

### DPSkin®

Benefiting from the** latest technologies**, the new version
of DP Skin now offers **19 skin and hair analysis criteria**.

[DPSkin ®][37]

### Lasera®

While being one of the safest diode laser on the market, Lasera is born
for **profitability and growth**. A powerful generator combined with a **safe technique**.

[Lasera ®][38]

### IPL Stella®

Benefit from **one of the long-lasting line of IPLs** through versatility
with **skin rejuvenation treatments** and long-lasting hair removal.

[IPL Stella ®][39]

### EstheLED®

Recognized for its action on cell regeneration, LED
photobiomodulation has many applications
in the field of beauty care.

[ESTHELED ®][40]

The **fastest diode laser** on the market for long-lasting hair removal
on every part of the body** for every skin types**. 

[Leaseir ®][41]

dedicated to assist you in your development **from the beginning with a detailed assessment of your
investment, to the end with training and maintenance.**

**Since 2005**, we pride ourselves in giving our clients the best experience to successfully run
their businesses. **Our devices answer a wide range of needs and will increase your profitability
while providing efficient results to your clients.**

Chemical & material, Energy Power, F & B, Retail, Healthcare and many more to provide high value
market research reports and consulting services. Our skilled analysts work towards understanding the
specific needs of each client to produce relevant insights that most suit his individual needs.
Since its inception, Data Insights Market has continued to innovate, increased its product and
service portfolio, and remained focused on the needs of its clients to root out poor-quality data
and establish itself as a winning partner for businesses. DIM has a legacy of serving and
facilitating clients from all over the world and played a vital role in their success story. Our
clients include many types of organizations, the majority of which are Fortune 500 companies.

The 360-degree research methodology requires us to only dispense facilities based on our unique data
model so that the authenticity and integrity of the services are maintained. This methodology makes
sure that the analysis is comprehensive and accurate. We can provide services of importance to our
clients well within the time limit by keeping a close eye on relevant press releases, official
publications, decades of trade data, technical and white papers. We also offer services based on the
following: We use a variety of new, useful approaches to big data and the tools of qualitative and
quantitative marketing research to understand clients properly. The key objectives are to examine
niche markets, outline the main drivers, and indicate the most hazardous obstacles. We track major
local and global trends in this field and strive to balance the quality level within a given time
period while meeting the specialized and specialty needs of the industry.

## FACELIFT T30 PRO™

The FACELIFT T30 PRO™ is a next-generation Endolift platform combining 1470nm and 980nm laser
technologies for facial lifting, skin tightening, and laser-assisted lipolysis. Developed for modern
aesthetic practices, it offers powerful performance, precise energy delivery, and professional
training support to help practitioners achieve safe and effective results.

[Continuous Education & Monthly Zoom Training][Continuous Education & Monthly Zoom Training]

At EndoTECH, we believe that successful treatments require more than advanced technology. That’s why
we provide monthly live Zoom training sessions led by experienced clinical trainers. These sessions
include treatment protocols, hands-on guidance, case reviews, and live Q&A, helping doctors and
practitioners continuously improve their skills and confidence with the T30 PRO system.

# Leafsnap: An Electronic Field Guide

Leafsnap is a series of electronic field guides being developed by researchers from [Columbia
University][14], the [University of Maryland][15], and the [Smithsonian Institution][16]. The free
mobile apps use visual recognition software to help identify tree species from photographs of their
leaves. They contain beautiful high-resolution images of leaves, flowers, fruits, petioles, seeds
and bark.

The original Leafsnap currently includes trees found in the Northeastern United States and Canada,
and will soon grow to include the trees of the entire continental United States. The high-resolution
images in the original app were created by the conservation organization. [Finding Species][17].

This website shows the tree species included in Leafsnap, the collections of its users, and the team
of research volunteers working to produce it.

The Leafsnap UK app includes trees from the United Kingdom with species information and imagery
provided by the Natural History Museum in London. More information can be found on the [Natural
History Museum website][18].

The City College of New York developed and tested curricular materials that use the Leafsnap app to
help middle school students notice, group, and contextualize street trees in the patterns of
evolution. Curricular guide and other educational materials are available from [here][19].

### Frequently asked questions

What is Modash and how does it work?
Modash is an influencer marketing platform that lets brands on Shopify manage and grow their
influencer programs from one place. Find creators, manage relationships, track performance, and pay
them in one connected workflow. Run paid partnerships, affiliate programs, and gifting campaigns
without juggling multiple tools or spreadsheets.
Is Modash a platform, an agency, or a marketplace?
Modash is a platform only. It's a software tool you use yourself to run your influencer marketing
program. We're not an agency (we don't run campaigns for you), and we're not a marketplace (creators
don't browse and apply to work with you). Think of Modash as your operating system for influencer
marketing: you're in full control, and we provide the tools to make everything faster and easier.
Can I use Modash if I’m not on Shopify?
Yes, you can use all our core features: discovery, management, tracking, and payments. But we focus
primarily on Shopify-connected stores, so you’ll get the most value if you’re on Shopify. Our
Shopify integration unlocks powerful features, like product gifting, affiliate programs, and
automatic sales tracking.
Will I find the creators I'm looking for?
Yes. Modash includes every public profile on Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube with over 1K followers.
That's 350M+ creators! You can use our AI-powered search or filter by location, niche, audience
demographic

### Frequently asked questions

What is Modash and how does it work?
Modash is an influencer marketing platform that lets brands on Shopify manage and grow their
influencer programs from one place. Find creators, manage relationships, track performance, and pay
them in one connected workflow. Run paid partnerships, affiliate programs, and gifting campaigns
without juggling multiple tools or spreadsheets.
Is Modash a platform, an agency, or a marketplace?
Modash is a platform only. It's a software tool you use yourself to run your influencer marketing
program. We're not an agency (we don't run campaigns for you), and we're not a marketplace (creators
don't browse and apply to work with you). Think of Modash as your operating system for influencer
marketing: you're in full control, and we provide the tools to make everything faster and easier.
Can I use Modash if I’m not on Shopify?
Yes, you can use all our core features: discovery, management, tracking, and payments. But we focus
primarily on Shopify-connected stores, so you’ll get the most value if you’re on Shopify. Our
Shopify integration unlocks powerful features, like product gifting, affiliate programs, and
automatic sales tracking.
Will I find the creators I'm looking for?
Yes. Modash includes every public profile on Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube with over 1K followers.
That's 350M+ creators! You can use our AI-powered search or filter by location, niche, audience
demographic

pHformula: It rebuilt my skin and made me extremely joyous. I recommend pHformula to anyone who

I would like to thank pHformula for their amazing service with deliveries to my house when I cannot

my skin is GLOW-ING, especially when I put on moisturizer after. I don’t even need foundation
anymore. I can’t wait to find out what more pHformula can do more for my skin.
*pHformula Success Story*

I’ve been usinf pHformula for about 2 years now and I really like it. My skin is extremely sensitive
and both oily and dry. So I was looking for a mild cleanser and cream and I finally found it. I use
the VITA C products and the E.X.F.O. cleanse. This combination ensures that my skin remains
incredibly hydrated and almost never has impurities. I would recommend it to everyone.

# Welcome to the Practice of Dr. Bryson G. Richards
# Board Certified Plastic Surgeon, Las Vegas NV

We would like to warmly welcome you to the private practice website of respected Plastic Surgeon &
Director Dr. Bryson G. Richards. We are a full-service plastic surgery practice located in Las
Vegas, Nevada and we are pleased to offer a broad range of procedures that are designed to safely
enhance your appearance and effectively fulfill your unique cosmetic goals.

The foundational core of our cosmetic surgery practice is the provision of exceptional results
without sacrificing the highest level of patient care.

Along with his professionally trained staff, Dr. Richards strives to create a tranquil, welcoming
office environment that puts patients at ease and helps to facilitate the successful outcome of
every aesthetic transformation that takes place within our walls.

Board Certified by the American Board of Plastic Surgery, Dr. Richards understands that medical
procedures may create feelings of anxiety for some patients, and he makes it a priority to remain
highly accessible to his patients throughout their aesthetic enhancement experience, helping to
assuage their fears and calm their nerves. Dr. Richards and his staff will thoroughly address your
pre- and post-procedural concerns to ensure that you are completely comfortable with every facet of
your treatment plan, and that you have a clear understanding about all of your procedural options.

# THE DAILY EDIT

[ [With Jéan Il Lido Summer 2026 Gives Vacation Style A Flirtier Read][With Jéan Il Lido Summer 2026
Gives Vacation Style A Flirtier Read] ][305]

### [With Jéan Il Lido Summer 2026 Gives Vacation Style A Flirtier Read][306]

[July 24, 2026][307]

With Jéan’s Il Lido collection takes the Euro-summer fantasy seriously, turning Positano-shot swim,
knits, faded florals, and coastal stripes into a suitcase-ready wardrobe.

[ [Chloé Winter 2026 Campaign Takes Romantic Dressing Into The Wild][Chloé Winter 2026 Campaign
Takes Romantic Dressing Into The Wild] ][308]

### [Chloé Winter 2026 Campaign Takes Romantic Dressing Into the Wild][309]

[July 24, 2026][310]

Chloé’s Winter 2026 campaign pairs flowing silhouettes and intricate ruffles with winter light,
coastal hillsides and a cast led by Raquel Zimmermann.

[ [Ow Collection Brings Copenhagen Minimalism To Going-Out Dressing][Ow Collection Brings Copenhagen
Minimalism To Going-Out Dressing] ][311]

### [OW Collection Brings Copenhagen Minimalism To Going-Out Dressing][312]

[July 24, 2026][313]

OW Collection turns going-out dressing into something sharper and cleaner, mixing Copenhagen
minimalism with sleek silhouettes, strong shapes, and after-dark energy.

[ [Adidas Originals Sport Taps Tate Mcrae For Its Streetwear-Meets-Training Debut][Adidas Originals
Sport Taps Tate Mcrae For Its Streetwear-Meets-Training Debut] ][314]

### [adidas Originals Sport Taps Tate McRae for Its Streetwear-Meets-Training Debut][315]

[July 24, 2026][316]

Tate McRae fronts adidas Originals Sport, a new women’s training collection built around
Superstar-inspired lines, flexible leggings and streetwear attitude.

[ [Simkhai Resort 2027 Lets The Materials Do The Talking][Simkhai Resort 2027 Lets The Materials Do
The Talking] ][317]

### [Simkhai Resort 2027 Lets The Materials Do The Talking][318]

[July 24, 2026][319]

Simkhai Resort 2027 trades a single storyline for fabric experiments, turning fringe, leather
strips, organza, rope knits, suede, and relaxed tailoring into the season’s real plot.

[ [Activewear][Activewear] ][320]

### [The Y2K Activewear Revival Feels Surprisingly Fresh][321]

[July 24, 2026][322]

The Y2K revival has found its way into activewear, but not in the way you might expect. Rather than
dressing for the gym, fashion insiders are reworking the era’s sportiest pieces for everyday wear.

[ [Hailey Bieber Leads Miu Miu'S Nocturnal Fall 2026 Campaign][Hailey Bieber Leads Miu Miu'S
Nocturnal Fall 2026 Campaign] ][323]

### [Hailey Bieber Leads Miu Miu’s Nocturnal Fall 2026 Campaign][324]

[July 23, 2026][325]

Hailey Bieber leads Miu Miu’s Fall 2026 campaign in nylon outerwear, trapper hats and sneaker-boots,
photographed after dark by Zoe Ghertner.

[ [Heirlome Resort 2027 Gives Artisan Craft A Sharper Transformation Arc][Heirlome Resort 2027 Gives
Artisan Craft A Sharper Transformation Arc] ][326]

### [Heirlome Resort 2027 Gives Artisan Craft A Sharper Transformation Arc][327]

[July 23, 2026][328]

Heirlome Resort 2027 turns personal transformation into clothing through serpent prints, coiled
satin, ruched georgette and honeycomb knits shaped by artisan craft.

### SOCIAL MEDIA

## This is us

## Discover the *excellence*

Vanguard Aesthetics is a dynamic and visionary distributor dealing in innovative medical aesthetic
devices and products with a keen focus in South East Asia.

## Our Mission

## "...provide *safe and proven* technologies..."

Our mission is to deliver and provide safe and proven technologies to our partners so that we can
create a positive impact to our providers and they in turn can direct an even bigger change by
helping people live & look better.

## Our Vison

## "... be the most  *trusted, efficient* partner..."

It is our vision to be the most trusted, efficient partner to all stake holders, and create a
company that has the largest sales network in the field of medical aesthetics in S.E.A.

## This is us

## Discover the *excellence*

Vanguard Aesthetics is a dynamic and visionary distributor dealing in innovative medical aesthetic
devices and products with a keen focus in South East Asia.

## Our Mission

## "...provide *safe and proven* technologies..."

It is our vision to be the most trusted, efficient partner to all stake holders, and create a
company that has the largest sales network in the field of medical aesthetics in S.E.A.

## Events

## What’s Happening

##### Merz Aesthetics 10th Golden Record Award

###### 8 February 2026

The Merz Aesthetics 10th Golden Record Award celebrated a decade of excellence, commitment and
collaboration with their partners at Renaissance Hotel & Convention Centre, Kuala Lumpur.
Congratulations to all our winners, and here’s to the next 10 years!

##### 2026 Merz Aesthetics Conference Malaysia

###### 8 February 2026

The 2026 Merz Aesthetics Conference kicked off 2026 with 12 top speakers from Malaysia and the
region, discussing advanced techniques, innovation and the future of medical aesthetics.

##### Density TEA

###### 12 January 2026

Density TEA (Tailored Excellence in Aesthetics) South East Asia at Fairmont Jakarta brought together
leading experts and over 200 doctors from across the region to celebrate excellence and innovation.

##### Sunmax LEAP Training Tour 2026

###### 5-7 January 2026

From Singapore to Johor to Kuala Lumpur – doctors across 3 cities came together to take their
mastery to the next level with the Sunmax LEAP Training tour in January 2026.

##### I-SWAM 2025

###### 5-7 December 2025

Vanguard Aesthetics joined i-SWAM 2025, Jakarta for insightful discussions, meaningful connections,
and a shared vision for what’s next!

##### Cutera Launch

###### 4 December 2025

Cutera made a splash in The Langham, Jakarta, with over 100 doctors from Singapore, Malaysia and
Indonesia

##### AMCADS 2025

###### 11 - 12 October 2025

Cutting edge insights, interactive discussions and enthusiasm to drive innovation and excellence
in our field – Vanguard is proud to be part of the tremendous success of AMCADS 2025.

##### Dr Nabil x Merz Masterclass

###### 12 August 2025

Vanguard had the privilege of hosting Dr. Nabil Fakih, who shared his expertise, artistry, and
global insights, empowering practitioners to redefine beauty with precision and innovation.

Disclaimer: Dr. Nabil Fakih Gomez has successfully acquired a Temporary Practising Certificate (TPC)
to legally practice in Malaysia — facilitated by Vanguard Aesthetics Sdn. Bhd

##### Aesthetic Medicine & Surgery Conference '25

###### 6-7 August 2025

From groundbreaking insights to hands-on learning and a vibrant exhibition of the latest
technologies - Vanguard Aesthetics was proud to be part of the knowledge shared and connections made
at AMSC 2025.

##### Merz ELEVATE 2025

###### 5 August 2025

Top doctors from all over Asia came together in Kuala Lumpur for a lively day of innovative
techniques, best-in-class science and practical insights.

##### Sunmax Deusaderm LIDO Malaysia Launch Symposium

###### 29 July 2025

Over 250 medical professionals, KOLs, and influencers from across Asia gathered at W Kuala Lumpur to
celebrate the official launch of Deusaderm LIDO in Malaysia!

##### Ultherapy “Love My Prime” Celebration

###### 15 July 2025

A special evening unfolded at The Starhill, Bukit Bintang, where we gathered with our Ultherapy
Prime clinic partners to honour a shared commitment to authenticity, excellence, and proven results.

##### Merz Aesthetics® 9th Golden Record Awards

###### 11 February 2025

## Frequently asked questions

Everything you need to know about creating wishlists, finding the perfect gift, and using WishDeck.

What is WishDeck?

WishDeck is a free AI-powered wishlist and gift discovery platform available on the web at
wishdeck.com and as an iOS app. You can create unlimited wishlists for any occasion — birthdays,
weddings, holidays, baby showers, anniversaries, or just a running list of things you love — and
share them with friends and family in one tap using a simple link that works in any browser, no
sign-up required. Add items from any online store by pasting a link or using the iOS share sheet,
and let the built-in AI Gift Assistant suggest personalized gift ideas in seconds whenever you're
stuck on what to give. Friends can silently reserve gifts on your list so nobody buys duplicates,
and surprises stay surprises. Rated 4.9 on the App Store, WishDeck has been used to add more than 1
million wishes.

Is WishDeck free?

Yes — WishDeck is free to use on the web and on iOS. Create unlimited wishlists, share them with
anyone, and try the AI Gift Assistant at no cost. The iOS app also offers an optional Premium
upgrade that unlocks Circles (control which friends see each wish) and unlimited AI Gift Assistant
searches.

How do I create a wishlist on WishDeck?

You can create a wishlist on the web at wishdeck.com or in the iOS app — both work the same way.
Just paste any product link (or tap Share → WishDeck on your phone) and WishDeck automatically pulls
in the product image and description, so your list looks great with zero manual editing.

Can I share my WishDeck wishlist with people who don't have the app?

Yes. Every wishlist gets a shareable link (wishdeck.com/yourusername) that anyone can open in a
browser — no app and no sign-up required. Friends and family can view your wishes instantly on any
device.

How does WishDeck's AI gift assistant work?

The AI Gift Assistant uses what it knows about the recipient — their interests and what they've
already wished for — to suggest personalized gift ideas in seconds. It's especially handy when a
friend's wishlist gives you the direction but you want more ideas like the ones they already love.

Can I reserve a gift on someone's wishlist so others don't buy the same thing?

Yes — both in the iOS app and on the web. Reserve any item silently from a friend's wishlist; the
recipient never sees who reserved what, but other gift-givers will, so nobody buys duplicates. All
your reservations live under Profile → Reservations, where you can see who you reserved for, extend
a reservation for more days, or cancel it anytime.

Is WishDeck available on Android?

Native iOS (iPhone and iPad) today; native Android is on the roadmap. In the meantime, wishdeck.com
works in any browser on any device — including Android phones, tablets, and desktops — so you can
create, view, and share wishlists right now.

Can I add items from any online store?

Yes. WishDeck works with any website — Amazon, Sephora, Nordstrom, Etsy, or your favorite small
shop. Just tap Share → WishDeck on any product page (or paste the URL into WishDeck) and the item is
saved with its image and description, ready to share.

Can my friends see who reserved a gift on my wishlist?

Friends viewing your wishlist can see which items are already reserved (so they don't buy a
duplicate), but they'll never see who reserved them. As the wishlist owner you don't see any
reservations by default — surprises stay surprises. You can choose to reveal reservations to see
what's been claimed, but you'll only see that an item is reserved, never who reserved it.

Can I make my wishlist private?

Yes. Go to Settings → Account Privacy to make your account friends-only — then only people you have
approved as friends can see your wishlist. Every account also has both a Private list (only you see)
and a Public list (open to everyone) by default, so you can keep some wishes truly personal while
still sharing others openly.

How do I create a wishlist for someone else — my kid, my partner, or anyone?

Just create a separate wishlist and give it a clear name like "Birthday for Mom," "Kids' Christmas,"
or "Husband's Wishlist." Add the wishes meant for them, then share the link with whoever's gifting.
Separate lists keep everything tidy — no mixing your kids' birthday wishes with your own — and let
you share each one with exactly the right people.

Can I share a specific wish only with certain people?

Yes — with Circles, a Premium feature in the WishDeck iOS app. Create a Family Circle, a
Best-Friends Circle, a Partner Circle — whatever fits — and decide which Circle sees each individual
wish. So your family Christmas list stays family-only, and the wishes you saved for your partner's
eyes only never accidentally show up in front of your coworkers.

## Frequently asked questions

Everything you need to know about creating wishlists, finding the perfect gift, and using WishDeck.

What is WishDeck?

WishDeck is a free AI-powered wishlist and gift discovery platform available on the web at
wishdeck.com and as an iOS app. You can create unlimited wishlists for any occasion — birthdays,
weddings, holidays, baby showers, anniversaries, or just a running list of things you love — and
share them with friends and family in one tap using a simple link that works in any browser, no
sign-up required. Add items from any online store by pasting a link or using the iOS share sheet,
and let the built-in AI Gift Assistant suggest personalized gift ideas in seconds whenever you're
stuck on what to give. Friends can silently reserve gifts on your list so nobody buys duplicates,
and surprises stay surprises. Rated 4.9 on the App Store, WishDeck has been used to add more than 1
million wishes.

Is WishDeck free?

Yes — WishDeck is free to use on the web and on iOS. Create unlimited wishlists, share them with
anyone, and try the AI Gift Assistant at no cost. The iOS app also offers an optional Premium
upgrade that unlocks Circles (control which friends see each wish) and unlimited AI Gift Assistant
searches.

How do I create a wishlist on WishDeck?

You can create a wishlist on the web at wishdeck.com or in the iOS app — both work the same way.
Just paste any product link (or tap Share → WishDeck on your phone) and WishDeck automatically pulls
in the product image and description, so your list looks great with zero manual editing.

Can I share my WishDeck wishlist with people who don't have the app?

Yes. Every wishlist gets a shareable link (wishdeck.com/yourusername) that anyone can open in a
browser — no app and no sign-up required. Friends and family can view your wishes instantly on any
device.

How does WishDeck's AI gift assistant work?

The AI Gift Assistant uses what it knows about the recipient — their interests and what they've
already wished for — to suggest personalized gift ideas in seconds. It's especially handy when a
friend's wishlist gives you the direction but you want more ideas like the ones they already love.

Can I reserve a gift on someone's wishlist so others don't buy the same thing?

Yes — both in the iOS app and on the web. Reserve any item silently from a friend's wishlist; the
recipient never sees who reserved what, but other gift-givers will, so nobody buys duplicates. All
your reservations live under Profile → Reservations, where you can see who you reserved for, extend
a reservation for more days, or cancel it anytime.

Is WishDeck available on Android?

Native iOS (iPhone and iPad) today; native Android is on the roadmap. In the meantime, wishdeck.com
works in any browser on any device — including Android phones, tablets, and desktops — so you can
create, view, and share wishlists right now.

Can I add items from any online store?

Yes. WishDeck works with any website — Amazon, Sephora, Nordstrom, Etsy, or your favorite small
shop. Just tap Share → WishDeck on any product page (or paste the URL into WishDeck) and the item is
saved with its image and description, ready to share.

Can my friends see who reserved a gift on my wishlist?

Friends viewing your wishlist can see which items are already reserved (so they don't buy a
duplicate), but they'll never see who reserved them. As the wishlist owner you don't see any
reservations by default — surprises stay surprises. You can choose to reveal reservations to see
what's been claimed, but you'll only see that an item is reserved, never who reserved it.

Can I make my wishlist private?

Yes. Go to Settings → Account Privacy to make your account friends-only — then only people you have
approved as friends can see your wishlist. Every account also has both a Private list (only you see)
and a Public list (open to everyone) by default, so you can keep some wishes truly personal while
still sharing others openly.

How do I create a wishlist for someone else — my kid, my partner, or anyone?

Just create a separate wishlist and give it a clear name like "Birthday for Mom," "Kids' Christmas,"
or "Husband's Wishlist." Add the wishes meant for them, then share the link with whoever's gifting.
Separate lists keep everything tidy — no mixing your kids' birthday wishes with your own — and let
you share each one with exactly the right people.

Can I share a specific wish only with certain people?

Yes — with Circles, a Premium feature in the WishDeck iOS app. Create a Family Circle, a
Best-Friends Circle, a Partner Circle — whatever fits — and decide which Circle sees each individual
wish. So your family Christmas list stays family-only, and the wishes you saved for your partner's
eyes only never accidentally show up in front of your coworkers.
